# Phostide

> Free, MIT-licensed Windows 11 OLED taskbar solution: moving fill while you work, hybrid idle Care when you step away, per-monitor control — painted into Explorer BackgroundFill, not a floating overlay.

Site: https://phostide.doticca.com
Source: https://github.com/teamdoticca/Phostide
Publisher: Doticca (https://doticca.com)
Full agent brief: https://phostide.doticca.com/llms-full.txt

## Product

- Platform: Windows 11 22H2+ (x64). Signed Setup.exe is per-user — no administrator rights.
- Standalone: does **not** require Windhawk, TranslucentTB, RainbowTaskbar, or any separate taskbar overlay.
- Mechanism: tray host injects ExplorerTAP into Explorer; paints each taskbar's own `BackgroundFill`. Icons, Start, tray, and clock stay on top. Quitting restores the normal Windows brushes. Does not modify system files.
- Themes: exactly five built-in — Rainbow, Sea Waves, Weather, Space, Aurora. There is **no theme editor** and no custom theme upload.
- Privacy: local by default — no account, no telemetry; themes work offline; optional GitHub update check and in-app Update now (downloads the signed Setup) only. The website uses cookieless Vercel Analytics (aggregate page views); the app does not.
- Distribution: signed Setup.exe and portable zip via GitHub Releases (also linked from the site); Scoop: `scoop bucket add doticca https://github.com/teamdoticca/scoop-bucket` then `scoop install doticca/phostide` (update with `scoop update phostide`).

## Settings (tray › Settings…)

Four tabs — do not confuse them:

| Tab | What it controls |
|-----|------------------|
| **Taskbar** | Scope **All** or monitor *N*, then theme + intensity (0–100%). Live preview; **Apply** commits. |
| **OLED Care** | Hybrid idle fill dim (Off/1/5/10/30m): full session AFK dims all bars; while you work, unused displays dim alone based on **cursor** monitor. Optional experimental chrome dim / clock micro-nudge (per idle bar only), night boost, pause when locked, pause in fullscreen (default on — per covered monitor). **OLED everyday preset** = care-only (does **not** change Taskbar theme/intensity). Live paint/pause status is on the **Monitors** tab per display. |
| **Monitors** | Per-display **on/off** (default all on), named from the monitor's EDID model (e.g. "Monitor 1 · LG 27GR95QE"); **Identify** shows each display's number on screen. Off = stock Windows taskbar. Live status per row: **painting** / **fullscreen** / **locked** / **off** / **paused** (Enable off). |
| **System** | App-global: **RENDERING** Auto / GPU / CPU (shared by every bar), Start with Windows, updates (**Update now**: downloads the signed Setup from this repo’s GitHub release, checks the Doticca signature and that it is newer, installs silently, Phostide restarts; **Check for updates automatically** (on by default, once a day, notifies once per new version; tray menu then offers **Install update vX**); optional **Include pre-releases**, off by default, also offers GitHub pre-releases), Copy diagnostics. |

Defaults on a fresh install / after reset: Aurora, 35% intensity, Auto rendering, OLED Care idle after 5 minutes, all monitors active. First run opens a Welcome step in Settings asking which displays are OLED (unchecked displays keep the stock taskbar). Settings file: `%APPDATA%\Phostide\settings.json`. Tray left-click toggles Enable (SoftSuspend); Exit restores stock brushes. Tray right-click menu: Pause for 1 hour, Pause until restart (never saved — the next start paints again), Theme submenu for all displays. Settings › System › Copy diagnostics copies a redacted report (version, Windows build, displays, settings, recent logs) for bug reports.

## Dual-monitor OLED recipe

1. Install Setup.exe (or run portable `Phostide.exe`).
2. Tray › Settings… › **Monitors** — leave the OLED on; uncheck the LCD (or other) display if you want it stock.
3. **Taskbar** › Apply to the OLED monitor number › pick **Aurora** (darkest on average; or **Space**) › modest intensity › **Apply**.
4. **OLED Care** › optionally **OLED everyday preset** (care defaults only) or set Idle after + care toggles › Apply. **System** › RENDERING **Auto**; optionally Start with Windows › Apply.

Honest limits: Phostide reduces locked-bright time (moving fill + idle Care); it is not a burn-in warranty. Themes move the fill; residual Windows chrome stays static unless experimental chrome Care is on (may no-op after XAML renames). Hybrid idle: AFK → all enabled bars; while active → unused displays follow the cursor. Care applies only to monitors left on.

## Not Phostide

- Not an overlay window on top of the taskbar
- Not Windows auto-hide
- Not a Windhawk mod and not dependent on Windhawk
- Not a theme editor / custom shader UI for end users
- Not a cloud service
